resources.string: Meerkly helps out from your phone while you\'re not using it. Sign in with your Meerkly account and you\'re good to go.
This opens your browser so you can sign in safely.
No browser found on this device to sign in with.
Meerkly is running quietly in the background and helping out. You don\'t need to do a thing — just leave Meerkly open.
Meerkly is reaching out to the network. This usually only takes a moment.
You\'re not helping out right now. Meerkly keeps trying in the background and picks up again on its own — your credits are safe in the meantime.
Meerkly couldn\'t link this device to your account, so it can\'t help out yet. Try signing out and back in.
Your credits are stored on your Meerkly account and are safe — the app just can\'t reach the server right now. They\'ll reappear once it reconnects.
Since you set up Meerkly here
Meerkly is switched on and doing its thing.
Meerkly isn\'t helping out until it reconnects. Nothing for you to fix.
We never touch your files or personal browsing.
Leave Meerkly running to keep on helping.
